notes: EHSHook(IPoolManager manager, address token) takes $poolManager (Ethereum mainnet 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90) and $token. Deploy directly by CREATE2 with low 14 address bits 0x20cc (beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta). Static 1.25% LP fee plus a hook fee of 2% of filled IMD, taken through return deltas and held as the hook's ERC-6909 IMD claims; when IMD is the specified side a reserve is taken in beforeSwap and afterSwap mints the excess over 2% of the real fill as an ERC-6909 claim owned by the calling swapper/router, which must burn it for its payer (routers that never burn claims strand it on partial fills, and an exact-output sell filling below its reserve leaves the seller owing IMD). Routers pass abi.encode(outputRecipient) as hookData; a buy of at least 10 IMD filled records 1% of the filled IMD for that recipient, capped by unowed accrued fees. Empty or malformed hookData never blocks a swap and records no reward (the calling router is never credited). Rewards are claimable only by/to the beneficiary via claimRewards()/payRecorded(address), never inside a swap. Fees not recorded as rewards have no recipient and stay in the hook permanently. No owner, setter or upgrade. Factory mints all 1e27 units to itself and distributes 90% liquidity / 10% swarm; initialPrice is provenance only.
